backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor with extensive user, provider, client, document, and job-related types, forming the core data model for the backend.
backend/migration.mo: Implements a placeholder migration module that returns an empty new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected files, components, test IDs, and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries of multiple frontend source files for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS base styles, theme variables, and dark mode color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document that loads the React app and configures PWA metadata and icons.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Declares the IC domain used for canister verification.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theming, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page displayed when the app cannot reach the network.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing versioned caching, offline support, and navigation fallbacks with special handling for IC routes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, profile checks, and routing between all major pages.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, support drawer, and main content slot.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button that manages Internet Identity login/logout with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: UI for selecting a user role and creating a basic initial profile before entering the app.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright, support link, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with role‑based navigation, branding, login, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Landing section with a placeholder demo video block.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Landing section displaying animated platform stats for clients and providers based on backend data.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Renders a role selection UI with three role cards and navigation logic based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a testimonials section with client reviews, ratings, and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides a form for entering or auto-detecting address and coordinates using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/location/Provide: Embeds a Google Map for a provider’s location and links to open navigation in Google Maps.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple messaging panel with message display, sending, and refresh simulation.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a dismissible, auto-hiding alert indicating whether a provider is engaged or not.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Handles an M-Pesa payment dialog flow to unlock provider contact details, with simulated processing.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options.
Displays a grid of demo featured providers with avatars, verification badges, ratings, and basic info.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Renders a provider avatar with an image or initials and adjustable sizing.
Shows a clickable provider card with avatar, verification and engagement badges, rate, category, and rating.
A dialog giving a detailed preview of a provider including ratings, availability, services, rate, and work samples.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Displays a paywall card explaining and charging a connection fee to unlock provider contact details.
frontend/src/components/providers/WorkSa: Lets providers upload, track progress, and remove work sample images with toast feedback.
Shows provider work sample thumbnails with a modal viewer supporting navigation and fullscreen display.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Displays a PWA install banner with platform-specific install flows and optional iOS instructions.
frontend/src/components/pwa/UpdateAvaila: Shows a banner when a service worker update is available, allowing refresh or dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Renders star ratings with support for half stars, various sizes, and rating text.
Provides an interactive 1–5 star rating input component with optional read-only mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: A drawer UI that exposes phone and email contact info for customer support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Animates a count-up value when the referenced element becomes visible using intersection observer.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Handles PWA install prompt availability, iOS detection, and triggering the install flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for fetching and mutating user, provider, and platform data.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Hook that detects service worker updates, exposes update availability, and triggers reload via skip-waiting.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and styles, including a themed landing hero background.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with IDs, labels, business types, and icons for use across the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, and React Query client.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Client authentication page handling Internet Identity login and account creation with profile load completion logic.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Authentication page for service providers using Internet Identity, handling login flow and profile loading. Renders login/create tabs and triggers completion once authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/ProviderDa: Admin-only panel for seeding and deleting all provider data with feedback alerts. Uses mutations for dataset operations and protects actions behind admin check.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin page to review, view details of, and verify provider profiles. Loads providers pending review and manages verification actions with status badges.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable list of service categories and an 'All Providers' option. Navigates to results based on selected category.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Client profile editing page for personal details, location, and bio data with validation and save mutations. Loads existing profile and tracks completion state.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Placeholder page for future map-based provider browsing. Shows static UI indicating map feature is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Placeholder page for future job management features. Displays static UI noting job tracking is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays detailed provider information, polls for engagement updates, and shows ratings, location, and unlock/payment options.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Shows a searchable list of provider results with category filtering and optional preview dialog with polling.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component showing hero, category shortcuts, stats, featured providers, testimonials, and demo content.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to view and edit their profile, identity fields, location, work samples, and engagement status.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Lets providers upload verification documents, view verification status, and track upload progress.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Provides functions to compute, format, and check remaining engagement time from a bigint timestamp.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Calculates a 10% connection fee and formats KES currency amounts.
frontend/src/utils/googleMaps.ts: Validates coordinates and generates Google Maps embed and navigation URLs.
Stores, retrieves, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage with validation.
frontend/src/utils/profileCompletion.ts: Provides validation helpers and functions to check whether client or provider profiles have all required fields filled, returning completeness status and missing field names.
frontend/src/utils/providerDisplayName.t: Generates a safe display name and initials for providers using fallbacks when fields are missing or invalid.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including support for hash-based routing and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the provider verification workflow features, requirements, and current state.
